404	    cardTimer = setTimeout(() => ckptCard.classList.add("hidden"), 3800);
405	  }
406	
407	  function setControls(locked) {
408	    if (!controlsEl) return;
409	    if (locked === controlsLocked && !controlsEl.classList.contains("hidden")) return;
410	    controlsLocked = locked;
411	    controlsEl.innerHTML = `
412	      <span class="control-item">
413	        <span class="control-label">To move</span>
414	        <span class="arrow-keys" aria-label="Arrow keys">
415	          <span class="key key-up">↑</span>
416	          <span class="key key-left">←</span>
417	          <span class="key key-down">↓</span>
418	          <span class="key key-right">→</span>
419	        </span>
420	      </span>
421	      ${locked ? `
422	        <span class="control-item">
423	          <span class="control-label">To look around</span>
424	          <span class="mouse-hint">
425	            <span class="mouse-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
426	            <span>move mouse</span>
427	          </span>
428	        </span>
429	      ` : ""}
430	      <span class="control-item">
431	        <span class="control-label">Bird's-eye view</span>
432	        <span class="key">M</span>
433	      </span>
434	      <span class="control-item">
435	        <span class="control-label">Return to orbit</span>
436	        <span class="key">B</span>
437	      </span>
438	    `;
439	    controlsEl.classList.remove("hidden");
440	  }
441	  function hideControls() {
442	    controlsLocked = null;
443	    controlsEl?.classList.add("hidden");
444	  }
445	
446	  function setModelOpacity(model, o) {
447	    model.traverse((n) => {
448	      if (n.material) { n.material.transparent = o < 1; n.material.opacity = o; }
449	    });
450	  }
451	
452	  // ---------- terminal ----------
453	  function currentStep() {
454	    if (reviewMode) return REVIEW_STEP;
455	    if (!termTarget) return null;
456	    return STEPS[termTarget.state] || null;
457	  }
458	  function renderTerminal() {
459	    const step = currentStep();
460	    if (!step) return;
461	
462	    if (reviewMode && listShown) {
463	      termHint.textContent = "# entire checkpoint list";
464	      termInput.textContent = "entire checkpoint list";
465	      termInput.classList.remove("is-dim");
466	      if (termCta) termCta.innerHTML = "";
467	      termList?.classList.remove("hidden");
468	      return;
469	    }
470	    termList?.classList.add("hidden");
471	
472	    // The hint is just the "why"; the actionable command/keys live in the CTA
473	    // below the input line, where they're the most prominent thing on screen.
474	    termHint.textContent = step.hint ? `# ${step.hint}` : "";
475	    if (step.type === "confirm") {
476	      termInput.textContent = `${step.question}  [y/n]`;
477	      termInput.classList.add("is-dim");
478	      if (termCta) termCta.innerHTML =
479	        `<span class="cta-label">PRESS</span>` +
480	        `<kbd class="cta-key cta-key-yes">Y</kbd><span class="cta-note">link checkpoint</span>` +
481	        `<kbd class="cta-key cta-key-no">N</kbd><span class="cta-note">skip</span>`;
482	    } else {
483	      termInput.textContent = buffer;
484	      termInput.classList.remove("is-dim");
485	      if (termCta) termCta.innerHTML =
486	        `<span class="cta-label">TYPE</span><span class="cta-cmd">${step.cmd}</span>`;
487	    }
488	  }
489	  function flashTerminal(text, ok) {
490	    if (!termMsg) return;
491	    clearTimeout(msgTimer);
492	    termMsg.textContent = text;
493	    termMsg.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err");
494	    termMsg.classList.add(ok ? "show-ok" : "show-err");
495	    msgTimer = setTimeout(() => termMsg.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err"), 2400);
496	  }
497	  function openTerminal(a) {
498	    if (terminalOpen) return;
499	    terminalOpen = true;
500	    termTarget = a;
501	    buffer = "";
502	    fp.detach();                      // freeze movement; keystrokes feed the terminal
503	    termMsg?.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err");
504	    termList?.classList.add("hidden");
505	    termEl?.classList.remove("hidden");
506	    renderTerminal();
507	  }
508	  function closeTerminal(dismiss) {
509	    if (!terminalOpen) return;
510	    if (dismiss && termTarget) dismissedMemory = termTarget;
511	    terminalOpen = false;
512	    termTarget = null;
513	    buffer = "";
514	    termEl?.classList.add("hidden");
515	    if (active) fp.attach();          // resume walking (addEventListener dedupes)
516	  }
517	  function submitCommand() {
518	    const step = currentStep();
519	    if (!step || step.type !== "command" || listShown) return;
520	    if (cmdMatches(buffer, step.accept)) {
521	      buffer = "";
522	      if (reviewMode) { showCheckpointList(); return; }
523	      runStep(termTarget);            // dormant → stage, recovered → commit
524	      flashTerminal("✓ ok", true);
525	      renderTerminal();
526	    } else {
527	      flashTerminal(`command not recognized — try:  ${step.cmd}`, false);
528	      buffer = "";
529	      renderTerminal();
530	    }
531	  }
532	  function showCheckpointList() {
533	    listShown = true;
534	    timerRunning = false;            // the run is complete — NOW the clock stops
535	    countdownEl?.classList.remove("is-low", "is-critical");
536	    if (termList) {
537	      termList.innerHTML = artifacts.map((a) =>
538	        `<div class="term-list-row"><span class="tl-id">` +
539	        `<span class="tl-key">Entire-Checkpoint:</span> ${a.id}</span>` +
540	        `<span class="tl-title">recovered: ${a.fragment.title}</span></div>`
541	      ).join("");
542	    }
543	    flashTerminal(`${artifacts.length} checkpoints linked · ship memory restored`, true);
544	    showTutorial("Memory restored — and something just woke up. Press Esc to close the terminal, then Enter to investigate.", 0);
545	    renderTerminal();
546	    onComplete?.();                  // Level 1 cleared — unlocks Level 2 in orbit
547	  }
548	
549	  // ---------- state transitions ----------
550	  function runStep(a) {
551	    if (a.state === "dormant") stage(a);
552	    else if (a.state === "recovered") commit(a);
553	  }
554	  function stage(a) {
555	    a.state = "recovered";
556	    teachOnce("staged",
557	      "Recovered and staged. Run `git commit` to freeze it — the clock is ticking.");
558	  }
559	  function commit(a) {
560	    a.state = "frozen";
561	    setModelOpacity(a.model, 1);
562	    const ice = makeIceBlock();
563	    ice.position.y = a.model.position.y + 0.6;
564	    a.iceY = ice.position.y;
565	    a.anchor.add(ice);
566	    a.ice = ice;
567	    teachOnce("committed",
568	      "Committed and frozen — locked in. Now Entire offers to link a checkpoint: press y to capture the session behind this commit.");
569	  }
570	  function confirmCheckpoint(yes) {
571	    const a = termTarget;
572	    if (!a || a.state !== "frozen") return;
573	    if (!yes) {
574	      flashTerminal("declined — without a checkpoint the ship can't track this commit. re-approach to link it.", false);
575	      closeTerminal(true);
576	      return;
577	    }
578	    checkpoint(a);
579	    if (allLinked()) {
580	      reviewMode = true;             // clock KEEPS running — the list is the finish line
581	      shipMeter?.classList.add("is-full");
582	      showTutorial("All banked! Now type `entire checkpoint list` before the clock hits 0:00 — hurry!", 0);
583	      renderTerminal();              // stay open → review step
584	    } else {
585	      closeTerminal(false);
586	    }
587	  }
588	  function checkpoint(a) {

625

631	
632	    // While the terminal is open, all keys feed it.

645	        e.preventDefault();
646	        return;
647	      }
648	      // command mode
649	      if (e.code === "Enter") { submitCommand(); e.preventDefault(); return; }
650	      if (e.code === "Backspace") { buffer = buffer.slice(0, -1); renderTerminal(); e.preventDefault(); return; }
651	      if (e.key && e.key.length === 1 && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) {

690	  function update(dt, t) {

693	    // Level countdown — one clock for the whole run.
694	    if (active && timerRunning && !failed) {
695	      timeLeft = Math.max(0, timeLeft - dt);
696	      updateClock();
697	      if (timeLeft <= 0) failLevel();
698	    }
699	    applyPanicSky();   // the sky reacts to the clock every frame
700	
701	    // Nearest memory within reach (ignoring height).
702	    let nearest = null, nd = Infinity;
703	    for (const a of artifacts) {
704	      const dx = camera.position.x - a.anchor.position.x;
705	      const dz = camera.position.z - a.anchor.position.z;
706	      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
707	      if (d < nd) { nd = d; nearest = a; }
708	    }
709	    target = nd <= INTERACT_DIST ? nearest : null;
710	
711	    // Auto open/close the ship's terminal as you reach a memory.
712	    // (In review mode the terminal is driven manually, so leave it alone.)
713	    if (active && started && !reviewMode && !failed && !devLevel2) {
714	      if (dismissedMemory && target !== dismissedMemory) dismissedMemory = null;
715	      const canOpen = target && target.state !== "checkpointed" && target !== dismissedMemory;
716	      if (canOpen && !terminalOpen) openTerminal(target);
717	      else if (!canOpen && terminalOpen) closeTerminal(false);
718	    }
719	
720	    for (const a of artifacts) {
721	      // Melting away after a time-out — sink and fade, then disappear.
722	      if (a.melting) {
723	        a.meltT = Math.max(0, a.meltT - dt);
724	        const k = a.meltT / MELT_DUR;
725	        setModelOpacity(a.model, k);
726	        a.model.position.y -= dt * 2.4;
727	        if (a.ice) a.ice.material.opacity = 0.62 * k;
728	        a.beam.visible = false;
729	        a.glow.visible = false;
730	        continue;
731	      }
732	
733	      const encased = a.state === "frozen" || a.state === "checkpointed";
734	
735	      // Idle spin/bob until the memory is encased in ice.
736	      if (!encased) {
737	        a.model.rotation.y += dt * 0.6;
738	        a.model.position.y = 1.4 + Math.sin((t + a.bobOff) * 1.5) * 0.4;
739	        setModelOpacity(a.model, 1);
740	      }
741	
742	      // Beam + glow: bright while findable, gone once frozen.
743	      const lit = a.state === "dormant" || a.state === "recovered";
744	      let o = 0;
745	      if (a.state === "dormant") o = 0.4 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.12;
746	      else if (a.state === "recovered") o = 0.22;
747	      a.beam.material.opacity = o;
748	      a.beam.visible = o > 0.01;
749	      a.glow.visible = lit;
750	    }
751	
752	    overhead.update(t);
753	    if (terminalOpen) renderTerminal(); // reflect fade-driven state changes
754	    if (active) refreshHud();
755	  }

136	// Convert lat/lon (degrees) to a point on a sphere of the given radius.
137	function latLonToVec3(lat, lon, radius) {
138	  const phi = (90 - lat) * (Math.PI / 180);
139	  const theta = (lon + 180) * (Math.PI / 180);
140	  return new THREE.Vector3(
141	    -radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta),
142	    radius * Math.cos(phi),
143	    radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta)
144	  );
145	}
146	
147	/**
148	 * Build debris anchors on the planet surface. Returns the group (to add to the
149	 * planet so they rotate together) and the list of pickable meshes for
150	 * raycasting, each carrying its fragment data in userData.
151	 */
152	export function createDebris(planetRadius) {
153	  const group = new THREE.Group();
154	  const pickables = [];
155	
156	  for (const frag of FRAGMENTS) {
157	    const pos = latLonToVec3(frag.lat, frag.lon, planetRadius);
158	    const anchor = new THREE.Group();
159	    anchor.position.copy(pos);
160	    // Orient so local +Y points away from the planet centre.
161	    anchor.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
162	      new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
163	      pos.clone().normalize()
164	    );
165	
166	    const model = BUILDERS[frag.kind]();
167	    model.position.y = 0.02;
168	
169	    // Halo to make it findable; doubles as the click target (big & flat).
170	    const halo = new THREE.Mesh(
171	      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.34, 0.34),
172	      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
173	        map: haloTexture(),
174	        transparent: true,
175	        blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
176	        depthWrite: false,
177	        opacity: 0.9,
178	      })
179	    );
180	    halo.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
181	    halo.position.y = 0.005;
182	
183	    anchor.add(halo, model);
184	    anchor.userData = { fragment: frag, halo, model, baseScale: 1 };
185	    group.add(anchor);
186	    pickables.push(anchor);
187	  }
188	
189	  return { group, pickables };
190	}
191

42	export function makeIdSprite(id) {
43	  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
44	  c.width = 768; c.height = 64;
45	  const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
46	  ctx.font = "bold 28px ui-monospace, monospace";
47	  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
48	  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(111,227,255,0.9)";
49	  ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
50	
51	  const key = "Entire-Checkpoint: ";
52	  const keyW = ctx.measureText(key).width;
53	  const idW = ctx.measureText(id).width;
54	  let x = (c.width - (keyW + idW)) / 2;       // center the whole trailer
55	  ctx.textAlign = "left";
56	  ctx.fillStyle = "#8fc4dc";                    // dim trailer key
57	  ctx.fillText(key, x, 34);
58	  ctx.fillStyle = "#dff3ff";                    // bright hash
59	  ctx.fillText(id, x + keyW, 34);
60	
61	  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
62	  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
63	  const spr = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
64	    map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, fog: false,
65	  }));
66	  spr.scale.set(30, 2.5, 1);                    // 12:1 canvas → keep text height
67	  return spr;
68	}

  "content": "import * as THREE from \"three\";\n\n// Meshes for the Level 1 shooter: the ship's RECORDS rain back down over the\n// crash site (shoot these — glowing gold), tangled up with dead WRECKAGE\n// (skip these — dark, jagged).\n//\n// Identity has to survive tumbling at arcade distance, so every record reads\n// from its SILHOUETTE, never a flat face. Mockup-tested 2026-06-14: key and\n// wrench read instantly; compass/gauge failed (face-dependent → gold coin) and\n// were dropped for the telescope + canister, which are unmistakable in profile.\n\n// Warm gold, self-lit so it pops against the lavender dusk sky even mid-tumble.\nfunction brass() {\n  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n    color: 0xe0a838, metalness: 0.95, roughness: 0.32,\n    emissive: 0x6a4310, emissiveIntensity: 0.6,\n  });\n}\n// Cold, matte, jagged — obviously not worth recovering.\nfunction darkMetal() {\n  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n    color: 0x2f333a, metalness: 0.25, roughness: 0.95, flatShading: true,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction add(group, geo, mat) {\n  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);\n  group.add(m);\n  return m;\n}\n\n// --- Key: round bow (torus) + shaft + teeth. Reads from any angle.\nfunction buildKey() {\n  const g = new THREE.Group();\n  const m = brass();\n  const bow = add(g, new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.55, 0.18, 16, 32), m);\n  bow.position.set(0, 0, 0.9);\n  const shaft = add(g, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.14, 0.14, 1.9, 20), m);\n  shaft.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n  shaft.position.set(0, 0, -0.35);\n  add(g, new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.16, 0.5, 0.16), m).position.set(0, -0.27, -1.05);\n  add(g, new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.16, 0.34, 0.16), m).position.set(0, -0.19, -1.32);\n  return g;\n}\n\n// --- Wrench: long handle + open-jaw head (a clear C/U notch).\nfunction buildWrench() {\n  const g = new THREE.Group();\n  const m = brass();\n  add(g, new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.34, 2.0), m).position.set(0, 0, 0.2);\n  add(g, new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.30, 0.34, 0.95), m).position.set(0.42, 0, -1.0);\n  add(g, new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.30, 0.34, 0.95), m).position.set(-0.42, 0, -1.0);\n  add(g, new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.14, 0.34, 0.30), m).position.set(0, 0, -0.7);\n  return g;\n}\n\n// --- Telescope: stepped tube (wide barrel → narrow draw-tube) + eyepiece ring.\n// Silhouette is an unmistakable tapered cylinder along its length.\nfunction buildTelescope() {\n  const g = new THREE.Group();\n  const m = brass();\n  const barrel = add(g, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.55, 1.5, 24), m);\n  barrel.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;\n  barrel.position.x = -0.55;\n  const draw = add(g, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.34, 0.42, 1.3, 24), m);\n  draw.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;\n  draw.position.x = 0.75;\n  // raised rings where the sections meet + the eyepiece, for a tooled read\n  const ring = add(g, new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.5, 0.1, 12, 24), m);\n  ring.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;\n  ring.position.x = -0.05;\n  const eye = add(g, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.3, 0.34, 0.28, 24), m);\n  eye.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;\n  eye.position.x = 1.45;\n  return g;\n}\n\n// --- Canister: capped cylinder + neck + valve + bands. Reads as a gas bottle.\nfunction buildCanister() {\n  const g = new THREE.Group();\n  const m = brass();\n  const body = add(g, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.62, 0.62, 1.7, 24), m);\n  body.position.y = -0.1;\n  // domed shoulder\n  const dome = add(g, new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.62, 24, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2), m);\n  dome.position.y = 0.75;\n  // neck + valve on top\n  add(g, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.2, 0.24, 0.3, 16), m).position.y = 1.05;\n  add(g, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.32, 0.32, 0.14, 16), m).position.y = 1.25;\n  // two bands around the body\n  for (const y of [0.25, -0.45]) {\n    const band = add(g, new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.63, 0.06, 10, 24), m);\n    band.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;\n    band.position.y = y;\n  }\n  return g;\n}\n\nconst RECORD_BUILDERS = [buildKey, buildWrench, buildTelescope, buildCanister];\n\n// --- Wreckage: jagged, dark, with a broken plate jutting out. Two silhouettes.\nfunction buildWreck(variant = 0) {\n  const g = new THREE.Group();\n  const geo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1.15, 0);\n  const p = geo.attributes.position;\n  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {\n    p.setXYZ(\n      i,\n      p.getX(i) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8),\n      p.getY(i) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8),\n      p.getZ(i) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8)\n    );\n  }\n  geo.computeVertexNormals();\n  add(g, geo, darkMetal());\n  if (variant === 0) {\n    const pl = add(g, new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.7, 0.12, 0.95), darkMetal());\n    pl.position.set(0.3, -0.2, 0.4);\n    pl.rotation.set(0.6, 0.3, 0.4);\n  } else {\n    const bar = add(g, new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.22, 1.8, 0.22), darkMetal());\n    bar.position.set(-0.3, 0.5, 0.2);\n    bar.rotation.set(0.4, 0, 0.5);\n  }\n  return g;\n}\n\nlet recordCursor = Math.floor(Math.random() * RECORD_BUILDERS.length);\n\n// A record mesh, cycling through the four shapes so a run shows variety.\nexport function makeRecord() {\n  const build = RECORD_BUILDERS[recordCursor % RECORD_BUILDERS.length];\n  recordCursor += 1;\n  const g = build();\n  g.userData.spin = randomSpin(1.4);\n  return g;\n}\n\n// A specific record shape by index (key=0, wrench=1, telescope=2, canister=3).\nexport function makeRecordOfType(type) {\n  const g = RECORD_BUILDERS[type % RECORD_BUILDERS.length]();\n  g.userData.spin = randomSpin(1.4);\n  return g;\n}\n\nexport function makeWreck() {\n  const g = buildWreck(Math.random() < 0.5 ? 0 : 1);\n  g.userData.spin = randomSpin(1.8);\n  return g;\n}\n\nfunction randomSpin(scale) {\n  return new THREE.Vector3(\n    (Math.random() - 0.5) * scale,\n    (Math.random() - 0.5) * scale,\n    (Math.random() - 0.5) * scale\n  );\n}\n\nexport const RECORD_TYPE_COUNT = RECORD_BUILDERS.length;\n"
}

> AGENT

Level 1 is rebuilt as the falling-records shooter and the production build is clean. Here's what landed:

**New mechanic** — you stand at the crash site behind a salvage cannon (mounted FPS-style at the bottom of the screen) that tracks your cursor. Records (glowing gold) and wreckage (dark, jagged) rain down over the wreck. Click to fire a laser bolt.

**Teaching is unchanged from today's Level 1** (per your call): shoot a gold record → the rain pauses, it hovers, the ship's terminal opens → type `git add` → `git commit` → press **Y to link a checkpoint**. Do that for all three, then run `entire checkpoint list` to review. Shooting wreckage is the penalty (−4s, red flash, screen shake). `explain` stays Level 2's command.

**What I verified by rendering it:**
- The four record shapes — **key, wrench, telescope, canister** — all read in gold with strong contrast against the dark wreckage and the lavender sky.
- The full scene composes well: sky up top, the crashed ship with its glowing cyan cockpit half-buried in the dune, cannon bottom-center angling its gold-tipped barrel up at the falling records.

**Files:**
- `src/fallingProps.js` (new) — record/wreckage mesh builders
- `src/islandView.js` — rewritten as the shooter (dropped the first-person walk + overhead map + dead Level-2 dev seed)
- `index.html` — new Level 1 briefing + aiming reticle
- `src/style.css` — reticle + hit-flash

A couple of things I decided so I could keep moving, easy to change once you play it: `TOTAL_TIME` is 90s (was 60 and "scary-tight"; new mechanic gets a little breathing room), spawn rate ~0.8s with ~58% records. 

I couldn't drive the full click-through in headless Chrome, so the live feel (cannon aim tracking, bolt timing, difficulty) is best judged by you — run `npm run dev` and land on the planet. Want me to adjust pacing, or is there anything off when you play it?

That black thing is the **crashed ship** I added as backdrop — your downed vessel half-buried in the dune at the crash site (`buildCrashedShip` in `islandView.js`). It's meant to be set dressing so the "crash site" reads, with a glowing cyan cockpit band, a snapped wing, and a tail fin.

But if it's just reading as a random black blob, then it's failing at its one job. A couple of things are probably working against it: the hull color is a dark gray that goes near-black in the lavender shadow, and the silhouette (a tilted cylinder + cone) doesn't obviously say "spaceship" at that distance.

Two ways to go:

1. **Make it clearly read as your crashed ship** — bigger and more central, a stronger ship silhouette (hull + fins + landing struts), warmer/lit metal with emissive trim and maybe a thin smoke plume, so it's unmistakably "the wreck you're salvaging records over." Reinforces the fiction.
2. **Cut it** — drop the ship entirely and let the terrain + sky be the whole backdrop. Cleaner, less risk of a confusing shape.

My recommendation is **#1** — the whole level is "salvage your records over the wreck," so having a recognizable wreck on screen earns its place. But it needs to actually look like a ship.

> AGENT

You're right, and I think I can name *why* it feels thin: right now nothing actually threatens you while you shoot. Records make up ~58% of the drops and missing one is free (more just keep raining), so the clock is the only stake — and at 90s for 3 records it's slack. It's "collect N, done." The fix isn't *more* records (each one is a typing pause to bank, so 5–6 banks would get tedious, not tense). It's making the recovering **fragile and escalating**.

Here are ideas, ranked by stakes-per-complexity:

**1. Records are scarce and losable (the core fix).** Flip the rain: mostly wreckage, records rare. If a record falls past you and smashes into the ground, it's *gone* — lost ship memory. Now every gold sighting is do-or-die instead of a freebie. This single change makes the clock and your aim suddenly matter.

**2. Escalation ramp.** Over the run, fall speed ↑, drop rate ↑, wreckage ratio ↑. Opens calm (tutorial), ends chaotic — the third record is the hard one. A real difficulty curve inside one timed run, zero new UI.

**3. Banking is a vulnerable window.** While you type `git add` / `git commit` / link, the rain *doesn't* pause — debris keeps falling, the clock keeps burning, a record could smash while your hands are on the keyboard. Recovering forces you to stop defending at the worst moment. (Right now I pause the rain — removing that pause is almost free and adds great tension.)

**4. Wreckage becomes a threat, not just a skip.** Debris that hits the ground unshot damages the ship — drains the memory meter or knocks seconds. So you must shoot wreckage *too* (to protect), but only records bank. Creates triage: grab the record, or clear the chunk about to land? This is the biggest jump in stakes — but it's a second mechanic, so it costs the most simplicity.

**5. Streak bonus (carrot).** Consecutive clean record hits build a multiplier that adds seconds; hitting wreckage breaks it. Rewards precision instead of spraying.

**My recommendation: #1 + #2 together** — scarce losable records on an escalation ramp. That turns "collect in time" into "don't let your memories smash, and it gets worse every second," with no new screens or commands and the teaching untouched. Add #3 if you want it genuinely sweaty. I'd hold #4 in reserve — it's the most fun *idea* but the least "simple," and it muddies the clean "gold = grab, dark = ignore" read you liked.

Want me to build #1 + #2 (and fold in #3)?

Got it — that's a score-attack: the clock is fixed, you grab as many records as you can, and there's a minimum you have to clear to pass. That's a stronger frame than "collect exactly N." Here's how I'd wire it so it still teaches:

- **The clock is the whole game.** No fixed record count — you recover records until 0:00.
- **Each recovery still costs the real loop** (`git add` → `git commit` → link). So the skill being tested is *how fast can you run the workflow under pressure* — which is also the thing the level teaches. The first couple show hints; after that they fade and you're flying.
- **Score = records recovered.** Ship-memory meter fills to 100% at the **minimum**; anything past that is bonus/overcharge.
- **Below the minimum at 0:00 = fail** ("not enough memory restored"). At or above = success, and your count is your run.
- Stakes ride on top: records get scarcer + fall faster as the clock drops, so clearing the minimum is real effort and pushing past it is greedy.

> AGENT

Good question — let me explain, since you picked the other option (End of clock).

**Cash-out** was the alternative I *didn't* use. The idea: the moment you hit the minimum, the level becomes finishable, and you'd get to *choose* when to stop. You could either:
- run `entire checkpoint list` right then to **lock in your score and end early** (play it safe), or
- **keep recovering** for a higher score while the clock keeps ticking — risking that if you get greedy and somehow lose your footing, you walked away from a guaranteed win.

"Cash out" = the gambling sense: take your winnings now vs. let it ride for more. The tension is *you* decide when enough is enough.

**You picked End of clock instead**, which is simpler: there's no early-stop choice — you just recover until 0:00 forces the end. If you cleared the minimum, the results screen has you run `entire checkpoint list` to review your haul and launch. No "should I stop now?" decision, just "grab as many as you can before time's up."

So the difference is only *who ends the run*: with cash-out it's your call (after the minimum); with end-of-clock the timer always calls it.

Want to stick with End of clock, or switch to cash-out now that it's clearer? I'll build whichever — just say the word.

> AGENT

End of clock at 40s. Let me reason about the minimum out loud, because the bottleneck isn't the shooting — it's the typing. Each record is: spot + aim + click, then type `git add` ↵, `git commit` ↵, `y`. Under pressure that's realistically ~7–9s per record (faster once it's muscle memory, slower while you're still learning the commands — which is most of Level 1's audience).

So in 40s:
- expert, no fumbles: ~6
- steady average player: ~4–5
- first-timer learning the commands: ~3–4

**I'd set the minimum at 4.** That demands a clean, no-hesitation run for an average player and leaves only a little slack for fumbles — hard but fair — while leaving 5–6+ as the "you're good at this" bonus ceiling. (If playtesting feels brutal we drop to 3; it's a one-line tune.)

623	    const raining = started && !banking && !reviewMode && !failed && !listShown;
624	    if (raining) {
625	      spawnTimer -= dt;
626	      if (spawnTimer <= 0) { spawnDrop(); spawnTimer = SPAWN_INTERVAL; }
627	    }
628	    for (let i = falling.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
629	      const f = falling[i];

631	      const spin = f.group.userData.spin;
632	      const spinTarget = f.group.userData.spinTarget || f.group;
633	      if (spin) {
634	        spinTarget.rotation.x += spin.x * dt;
635	        spinTarget.rotation.y += spin.y * dt;
636	        spinTarget.rotation.z += spin.z * dt;
637	      }
638	      if (f.kind === "record") {
639	        const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 5 + f.group.position.x * 0.13);

643	      }
644	      if (f.group.position.y <= DESPAWN_Y) removeFalling(f);
645	    }
646

Hard but not impossible —\n// each record costs the full git add/commit/link loop, so it's a race against\n// your own typing as much as the clock.\nconst TOTAL_TIME = 40;       // seconds in the run\nconst MIN_TO_PASS = 4;       // recover at least this many or the run fails\nconst WRECK_PENALTY = 4;     // seconds lost for shooting wreckage\nconst LOW_TIME = 15;         // clock turns urgent (red, pulsing) under this\nconst CRIT_TIME = 6;         // clock goes CRITICAL (fast pulse) under this\nconst PANIC_TIME = 15;       // the SKY starts shifting toward panic-red under this\n\n// Falling field — a vertical plane in front of the cannon.\nconst PLANE_Z = 0;\nconst SPAWN_Y = 56;\nconst DESPAWN_Y = 1.0;\nconst SPAWN_X = 32;          // half-width records can fall within\nconst RECORD_SCALE = 3.0;\nconst WRECK_SCALE = 2.6;\nconst MAX_FALLING = 8;\n\n// Escalation — the run gets harder as the clock drains (0 at start, 1 at 0:00):\n// drops come faster, records get scarcer, everything falls quicker.\nconst SPAWN_MAX = 0.85;      // seconds between drops, early\nconst SPAWN_MIN = 0.42;      // seconds between drops, late\nconst RECORD_CHANCE_START = 0.55;\nconst RECORD_CHANCE_END = 0.34;\nconst FALL_BASE = 8;\nconst FALL_VAR = 4;\nconst FALL_RAMP = 1.4;       // top speed = base * (1 + FALL_RAMP) near the end\nfunction lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }"

> AGENT

Done. Level 1 is now a score-attack:

**The run** — 40-second clock. You recover as many records as you can; each one still costs the full `git add` → `git commit` → link-checkpoint loop, so the race is against your own typing as much as the timer.

**The bar** — you need at least **4** to power the ship. The ship-memory meter fills to 100% at the minimum and overcharges past it. A new readout under the clock (top-left) shows "**N recovered · min 4**" and turns green the moment you clear the minimum.

**Escalation** — as the clock drains, records get scarcer and everything falls faster, so the back half is the hard part. Clearing 4 takes a clean run; 5–6+ is the "you're good" zone.

**The end** — at 0:00:
- **Cleared the minimum** → terminal opens, you run `entire checkpoint list` to review your haul, and Enter advances to the drone bay.
- **Fell short** → "NOT ENOUGH MEMORY — you recovered N, the ship needs at least 4," press R to retry.

Shooting wreckage still costs −4s + a red flash + shake. Build's clean.

On the minimum: I set it to **4** as the hard-but-fair line, but that's the number most worth feeling out in play. Run `npm run dev`, land, and see if 4-in-40s lands where you want — it's a one-line change (`MIN_TO_PASS`) and the timer is one too (`TOTAL_TIME`) if 40s feels off once the escalation is in your hands.

Done. Changes:

- **Removed the ship-memory bar** entirely — it was redundant with the score and overlapping the readout.
- **Repurposed the tally into a single `N / M` score** under the clock: reads `0/5` at the start, `5/5` when you clear it, and keeps climbing to `7/5` etc. for bonus. It turns green at the minimum and the count gets an extra glow once you're over.
- **Minimum is now 5** (briefing, readout, and pass threshold all match), since 6-in-40s was a stretch.

Build's clean. The `N/M` format means there's no separate "minimum thing" to cover anymore — the slash *is* the minimum, always visible right next to your count. Give it a play and see if 5 feels like the right wall now.

> AGENT

Yeah, I see exactly what you mean. Here's the contrast laid out:

**The intro reads like a story.** "First Memories" — *"You've crash-landed on a lavender world. The impact flung the ship's records skyward…"* It has a voice. You're a person in a place.

**The in-play instructions read like a tutorial popup.** These are the `teachOnce` toasts that fire while you're shooting:
- *"Record caught mid-air! Bank it before time's up: type `git add` to stage it."*
- *"Staged. Now `git commit` to freeze it — the clock is ticking."*
- *"That was dead wreckage — it cost you time. Shoot the glowing gold records."*

They're doing a job (telling you which key to press), but they snap you out of the world. It's the difference between a narrator and a manual.

A few directions we could take it — curious which feels right to you:

**1. Keep the voice going.** Whoever wrote that opening transmission keeps talking to you. Instead of *"type `git add` to stage it,"* it's something like *"Got one. Pull it into the buffer — `git add` —"* . Same command, but it sounds like a person on the comms, not a label.

**2. Make the commands feel diegetic.** Right now `git add` / `git commit` are presented *as* commands ("type this"). We could frame them as the ship's actual salvage process — staging = "loading the recovery clamp," commit = "freezing it solid" — and let the command be the thing you do, not the thing you're told to type. Risk: it gets less clear *that you're learning real git*, which is kind of the whole point.

**3. It's really about *where* the words live.** The intro is a calm card you read before the clock starts. The instructions are tiny toasts you skim mid-panic with a 40-second timer bleeding out. Even beautiful prose gets blown past at second 30. So part of this might not be the writing — it might be that the teaching wants to happen *before* the pressure, and the in-play text should shrink to almost nothing (a one-word nudge: "STAGE →", "COMMIT →").

My honest instinct: **a blend of 1 and 3.** Give the toasts a consistent voice so they feel like the same narrator, *but* lean on the briefing (and maybe a slow, unpressured first record) to do the real teaching — so by the time the clock matters, the toasts are reminders, not lessons.

What's pulling at you most — the *tone* of the instruction text, or the *timing* of when it hits you?

> AGENT

I love this. You're basically splitting it into **"what do I do"** (up front, tiny) and **"why does it work"** (the moment it first matters, big and beautiful). That's a much better shape than dumping everything in the briefing.

Here's how I'd frame it back to you:

**The new briefing — short, pilot voice, no git at all:**
> *Records are falling out of the sky — the crash threw them loose. We need to catch them before they hit.*
> *Aim with your mouse, click to shoot. Hit the glowing gold ones — that's the real data. Shoot the dead wreckage and you'll lose points.*

That's it. No "type git add, then commit, then y." Nobody needs that until they've actually hit something.

**Then the first record you shoot triggers the big card** — same design language as the story (gold banner, big words, calm) — and *this* is where git gets taught, one beat at a time with the why:
> **STAGE IT** · `git add`
> *Pull the record out of the wreckage and set it on the recovery clamp.*
>
> **FREEZE IT** · `git commit`
> *Lock it in — now it can't be lost.* (ice forms here)
>
> **REMEMBER IT** · press `y`
> *File it into the ship's memory as a checkpoint. That's what makes it recoverable later.*

After that first one, the big card never shows again — subsequent records just open the terminal with at most a tiny one-word nudge, or nothing. They already learned it.

Two things I want to get your call on before I build it:

1. **The clock.** That first teaching card should *pause the timer* — it's the lesson, not part of the 40-second race. Pressure starts on record #2. Agree?

2. **The big card on the first record — one screen or stepped?** Either it shows all three steps at once (read, then go do them in the terminal), or it reveals them one at a time *as you type each command* (type `git add` → the STAGE panel lights up and explains, then FREEZE appears, etc.). The stepped version is more magical and keeps the big-text style present through the whole first salvage, but it's more work. I lean stepped.

Want me to mock up the actual copy + layout for that first-record card so you can see it before we touch code?

> AGENT

Found the collision. Here's what's actually happening:

- **`.mission-lesson`** (your big story-style card) is pinned at `bottom: 188px`, full width, big text — the STAGE IT / FREEZE IT / REMEMBER IT panel.
- **`#terminal`** (where you actually type `git add`) is pinned at `bottom: 70px`, centered, its own bordered box.

So during the first record, **both are on screen at once, stacked a hair apart** — the beautiful card up top explaining the *why*, and a totally separate little terminal box below it for the *typing*. Two surfaces competing for your eyes. That's the "overlaid / crowded" feeling. They're not even really teaching together; they're two different instruction UIs fighting.

The fix isn't spacing — it's that **there should be one surface, not two.** A few ways to resolve it:

**A — Fold the typing into the card (my pick).** The story card *is* the terminal for the first record. You read "**STAGE IT** · *pull the record off the wreckage*" and the blinking `> git add` input lives right there at the bottom of that same gold panel. No separate terminal box. One place to look, exactly the "big words, gold banner" feel you wanted — and you watch the word you type appear inside the story. After the first record's done teaching, records #2+ just use the plain little terminal as-is (quick reminder, no card).

**B — Separate them in time, not space.** Show the big card alone (clock paused), no terminal. Read it → press Space → card clears → *then* the terminal slides in to type into. Teach, then do. Cleaner but it's two taps per step and you lose the "see it as you type it" magic.

**C — Just keep both, fix the crowding.** Card stays up top for the why, terminal stays at the bottom for the typing, with real breathing room and a visual line connecting them. Least work, but you're still asking the eye to ping-pong between two boxes.

I'd go **A** — it's the truest to what you described (the instruction living *inside* the story design), and it kills the two-box problem entirely instead of just spacing it out.

Want me to mock up what the merged card-with-input looks like (layout + the copy for all three steps) before I wire it?

> DEVELOPER

if we went with a..how does it look after the first shot though..like second shot..third shot?

> AGENT

Right, that's the important half — the first shot is the lesson, but shots 2/3/4 are the actual *game*, and they have to feel fast. Here's how A plays out across a run:

**Shot 1 — the teach (clock paused).**
Full gold story card. Input folded into the bottom of it. Stepped: you type `git add` → the card flips to **FREEZE IT** → `git commit` (ice forms) → **REMEMBER IT** → press `y`. Each step shows the one-line *why*. Big words, story voice. This is the only time the big card ever appears.

**Shot 2+ — muscle memory (clock running).**
The big card is **gone for good.** Hitting a record just pops the small existing terminal box at the bottom — no story panel, no big text, no "why." Just:

```
> git add
> git commit
> y
```

The only scaffolding is a tiny one-word cue in the terminal's hint line that advances with you — `stage` → `freeze` → `link` — so the rhythm stays without anything to *read*. By shot 3 most people aren't even looking at the cue; they're just typing the loop.

So the arc is: **shot 1 teaches loudly and slowly, every shot after is quiet and quick.** The big gold design shows up exactly once, which is what keeps it special instead of becoming the "random words popping up" problem you didn't like.

One sub-decision for shots 2+: the tiny cue word — **keep it** (`stage/freeze/link` ghosting in the hint line) or **drop it entirely** (pure recall, just `>`). I lean keep-it for the first playthrough; it's nearly invisible but saves the person who blanks on step 2. 

Want me to build A on that arc — loud card on shot 1, quiet terminal with the ghost cue after — and you playtest it?

232	  let timerRunning = false;
233	  let timedRunStarted = false;
234	  let failed = false;
235	  let started = false;
236	  let briefingIndex = 0;
237	  let modePromptState = null;
238	
239	  // ---------- HUD helpers ----------
240	  function setPrompt(text) {
241	    if (!promptEl) return;
242	    if (text) { promptEl.textContent = text; promptEl.classList.remove("hidden"); }
243	    else promptEl.classList.add("hidden");
244	  }
245	  function showTutorial(text, ms = 5500) {
246	    if (!tutorialEl) return;
247	    clearTimeout(tutorialTimer);
248	    tutorialEl.textContent = text;
249	    tutorialEl.classList.remove("hidden");
250	    if (ms > 0) tutorialTimer = setTimeout(() => tutorialEl.classList.add("hidden"), ms);
251	  }
252	  // Score readout: recovered / minimum (e.g. 0/5 → 5/5 → 7/5). Goes green +
253	  // "overcharged" once you're past the minimum.
254	  function updateTally() {
255	    if (stCount) stCount.textContent = String(banked);
256	    if (stMin) stMin.textContent = String(MIN_TO_PASS);
257	    if (stFill) stFill.style.width = Math.min(100, (banked / MIN_TO_PASS) * 100) + "%";
258	    tallyEl?.classList.toggle("is-met", banked >= MIN_TO_PASS);
259	    tallyEl?.classList.toggle("is-over", banked > MIN_TO_PASS);
260	  }
261	  function restartTextAnimation(el) {
262	    if (!el) return;
263	    el.classList.remove("beat-in");
264	    void el.offsetWidth;
265	    el.classList.add("beat-in");
266	  }
267	  function renderBriefingBeat() {
268	    if (!briefingText) return;
269	    briefingText.textContent = BRIEFING_BEATS[briefingIndex] || "";
270	    restartTextAnimation(briefingText);
271	    if (briefingNext) briefingNext.textContent = "to continue";
272	  }
273	  function advanceBriefing() {
274	    if (started) return;
275	    if (briefingIndex < BRIEFING_BEATS.length - 1) {
276	      briefingIndex += 1;
277	      renderBriefingBeat();
278	      return;
279	    }
280	    showModePrompt("tutorial");
281	  }
282	  function showModePrompt(kind) {
283	    const prompt = MODE_PROMPTS[kind];
284	    if (!prompt || !modePrompt) return;
285	    modePromptState = kind;
286	    timerRunning = false;
287	    tutorialEl?.classList.add("hidden");
288	    hideBankLesson();
289	    closeTerminal();
290	    briefingEl?.classList.add("hidden");
291	    if (modeAction) modeAction.textContent = prompt.action;
292	    if (modeNote) modeNote.textContent = prompt.note;
293	    modePrompt.dataset.mode = kind;
294	    modePrompt.classList.remove("hidden");
295	  }
296	  function visibleModePromptKind() {
297	    if (!modePrompt || modePrompt.classList.contains("hidden")) return null;
298	    if (modePrompt.dataset.mode) return modePrompt.dataset.mode;
299	    const action = modeAction?.textContent?.trim();
300	    if (action === MODE_PROMPTS.level.action) return "level";
301	    if (action === MODE_PROMPTS.tutorial.action) return "tutorial";
302	    return null;
303	  }
304	  function hideModePrompt() {
305	    if (modePrompt) {
306	      modePrompt.classList.add("hidden");
307	      delete modePrompt.dataset.mode;
308	    }
309	    modePromptState = null;
310	    modeAction?.blur();
311	  }
312	  function acceptModePrompt() {
313	    const acceptedMode = visibleModePromptKind() || modePromptState;
314	    if (!acceptedMode) return;
315	    hideModePrompt();
316	    if (acceptedMode === "tutorial") {
317	      startLevel();
318	    } else if (acceptedMode === "level") {
319	      startTimedRun();
320	    }
321	  }
322	  function renderBankLesson() {
323	    const lesson = BANK_LESSONS[bankState];
324	    if (!lesson || !missionLesson) return;
325	    if (missionLessonKicker) missionLessonKicker.textContent = lesson.kicker;
326	    if (missionLessonTitle) missionLessonTitle.textContent = lesson.title;
327	    if (missionLessonText) {
328	      missionLessonText.textContent = lesson.text;
329	      restartTextAnimation(missionLessonText);
330	    }
331	    if (missionLessonCue) missionLessonCue.textContent = lesson.cue;
332	    missionLesson.classList.remove("hidden");
333	  }
334	  function hideBankLesson() {
335	    missionLesson?.classList.add("hidden");
336	  }
337	  function pauseForBankLesson() {
338	    lessonPaused = true;
339	    lessonNarrating = true;
340	    timerRunning = false;
341	    tutorialEl?.classList.add("hidden");
342	    closeTerminal();
343	    renderBankLesson();
344	  }
345	  function openBankLessonTerminal() {
346	    if (!lessonPaused || !lessonNarrating) return;
347	    lessonNarrating = false;
348	    hideBankLesson();
349	    buffer = "";
350	    openTerminal();
351	  }
352	  function finishBankLesson() {
353	    if (!lessonPaused) return;
354	    lessonPaused = false;
355	    lessonNarrating = false;
356	    bankLessonComplete = true;
357	    hideBankLesson();
358	  }
359	  function startTimedRun() {
360	    if (failed || reviewMode || listShown) return;
361	    if (modePrompt) {
362	      modePrompt.classList.add("hidden");
363	      delete modePrompt.dataset.mode;
364	    }
365	    modePromptState = null;
366	    modeAction?.blur();
367	    lessonPaused = false;
368	    lessonNarrating = false;
369	    closeTerminal();
370	    timedRunStarted = true;
371	    timerRunning = true;
372	    updateClock();
373	    refreshHud();
374	  }
375	
376	  // ---------- level countdown / panic sky ----------
377	  function fmtTime(s) {
378	    s = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(s));
379	    return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
380	  }
381	  function updateClock() {
382	    if (countdownTime) countdownTime.textContent = fmtTime(timeLeft);
383	    countdownEl?.classList.toggle("is-low", timerRunning && timeLeft <= LOW_TIME);
384	    countdownEl?.classList.toggle("is-critical", timerRunning && timeLeft <= CRIT_TIME);
385	  }
386	  function panicFactor() {
387	    if (failed) return 1;
388	    if (!timerRunning || timeLeft > PANIC_TIME) return 0;
389	    let p = (PANIC_TIME - timeLeft) / PANIC_TIME;
390	    p *= p;
391	    if (timeLeft <= CRIT_TIME) {
392	      const throb = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 85);
393	      p += 0.14 * throb;
394	    }
395	    return Math.min(1, p);
396	  }
397	  function applyPanicSky() {
398	    const p = panicFactor();
399	    scene.background.copy(SKY_CALM).lerp(SKY_PANIC, p);
400	    scene.fog.color.copy(SKY_CALM).lerp(FOG_PANIC, p);
401	    dome.material.color.copy(DOME_CALM).lerp(DOME_PANIC, p);
402	    sun.color.copy(SUN_CALM).lerp(SUN_PANIC, p * 0.85);
403	  }
404	
405	  // ---------- spawning / falling ----------
406	  function clearFalling() {
407	    for (const f of falling) fallGroup.remove(f.group);
408	    falling.length = 0;
409	  }
410	  // How far into the run we are: 0 at the start, 1 at 0:00.
411	  function difficulty() {
412	    return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 1 - timeLeft / TOTAL_TIME));
413	  }
414	  function spawnDrop() {
415	    if (falling.length >= MAX_FALLING) return;
416	    const d = difficulty();
417	    const isRecord = Math.random() < lerp(RECORD_CHANCE_START, RECORD_CHANCE_END, d);
418	    const group = isRecord ? makeRecord() : makeWreck();
419	    group.scale.setScalar(isRecord ? RECORD_SCALE : WRECK_SCALE);
420	    group.position.set(
421	      (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * SPAWN_X,
422	      SPAWN_Y + Math.random() * 10,
423	      PLANE_Z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5
424	    );
425	    group.userData.kind = isRecord ? "record" : "wreck";
426	    fallGroup.add(group);
427	    const vy = (FALL_BASE + Math.random() * FALL_VAR) * (1 + FALL_RAMP * d);
428	    falling.push({ group, kind: isRecord ? "record" : "wreck", vy });
429	  }
430	
431	  // ---------- shooting ----------
432	  function fire() {
433	    if (!started || failed || banking || reviewMode || listShown || visibleModePromptKind()) return;
434	    // Aim ray from the camera through the cursor.
435	    raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);
436	    const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(fallGroup.children, true);
437	    let hitObj = null, hitPoint = null;
438	    if (hits.length) {
439	      hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
440	      let o = hits[0].object;
441	      while (o.parent && o.parent !== fallGroup) o = o.parent;
442	      hitObj = o;
443	    } else {
444	      hitPoint = aimPoint.clone();
445	    }
446	    spawnBolt(hitPoint);
447	    if (!hitObj) return;
448	    const entry = falling.find((f) => f.group === hitObj);
449	    if (!entry) return;
450	    if (entry.kind === "record") {
451	      // Pull it out of the falling list but keep it in the scene — it becomes
452	      // the captured record we bank, hovering in view until it's checkpointed.
453	      const i = falling.indexOf(entry);
454	      if (i >= 0) falling.splice(i, 1);
455	      startBank(entry.group);
456	    } else {
457	      // wrong target — costs time
458	      removeFalling(entry);
459	      spawnSpark(hitObj.position.clone(), 0xff5a3c);
460	      if (timedRunStarted) {
461	        timeLeft = Math.max(0, timeLeft - WRECK_PENALTY);
462	        updateClock();
463	      }
464	      flashScreen();
465	      shakeT = 0.25;
466	    }
467	  }
468	  function removeFalling(entry) {
469	    fallGroup.remove(entry.group);
470	    const i = falling.indexOf(entry);
471	    if (i >= 0) falling.splice(i, 1);
472	  }
473	
474	  function spawnBolt(target) {
475	    const muzzle = cannon.localToWorld(MUZZLE_LOCAL.clone());
476	    const dir = target.clone().sub(muzzle);
477	    const len = dir.length();
478	    const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.18, len, 8);
479	    geo.translate(0, len / 2, 0);
480	    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
481	      color: 0x9bf0ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9,
482	      blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, fog: false,
483	    });
484	    const bolt = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
485	    bolt.position.copy(muzzle);
486	    bolt.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dir.normalize());
487	    scene.add(bolt);
488	    effects.push({ obj: bolt, life: 0.14, max: 0.14, kind: "bolt" });
489	  }
490	  function spawnSpark(pos, color) {
491	    const s = new THREE.Mesh(
492	      new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.4, 12, 12),
493	      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
494	        color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.95,
495	        blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, fog: false,
496	      })
497	    );
498	    s.position.copy(pos);
499	    scene.add(s);
500	    effects.push({ obj: s, life: 0.3, max: 0.3, kind: "spark" });
501	  }
502	  function updateEffects(dt) {
503	    for (let i = effects.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
504	      const e = effects[i];
505	      e.life -= dt;
506	      const k = Math.max(0, e.life / e.max);
507	      if (e.kind === "bolt") e.obj.material.opacity = 0.9 * k;
508	      else { e.obj.material.opacity = 0.95 * k; e.obj.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - k) * 1.8); }
509	      if (e.life <= 0) { scene.remove(e.obj); e.obj.geometry.dispose(); effects.splice(i, 1); }
510	    }
511	  }
512	  function flashScreen() {
513	    document.body.classList.add("hit-flash");
514	    setTimeout(() => document.body.classList.remove("hit-flash"), 160);
515	  }
516	
517	  // ---------- banking flow ----------
518	  function startBank(recordGroup) {
519	    banking = true;
520	    bankTarget = recordGroup;
521	    bankState = "dormant";
522	    buffer = "";
523	    // The shot record stops mid-air where you hit it and hangs there, glowing,
524	    // while you bank it — NO ice yet. The rain keeps falling around you (records
525	    // you can't grab while your hands are on the keyboard slip past). It only
526	    // freezes into ice once you `git commit` it (see advanceBank).
527	    spawnSpark(recordGroup.position.clone(), 0xffd27a);
528	    if (!bankLessonComplete) pauseForBankLesson();
529	    else openTerminal();
530	  }
531	  // git commit = freeze the change → encase the held record in ice.
532	  function freezeBankTarget() {
533	    if (!bankTarget || bankIce) return;
534	    const ice = makeIceBlock();
535	    ice.position.copy(bankTarget.position);
536	    ice.scale.setScalar(1.5);
537	    fallGroup.add(ice);
538	    bankIce = ice;
539	    spawnSpark(bankTarget.position.clone(), 0xbfe9ff);
540	  }
541	  function clearBankPiece() {
542	    if (bankTarget) { fallGroup.remove(bankTarget); bankTarget = null; }
543	    if (bankIce) { fallGroup.remove(bankIce); bankIce = null; }
544	  }
545	  function currentStep() {
546	    if (reviewMode) return REVIEW_STEP;
547	    return STEPS[bankState] || null;
548	  }
549	  function openTerminal() {
550	    terminalOpen = true;
551	    termMsg?.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err");
552	    termList?.classList.add("hidden");
553	    termEl?.classList.remove("hidden");
554	    renderTerminal();
555	  }
556	  function closeTerminal() {
557	    terminalOpen = false;
558	    termEl?.classList.add("hidden");
559	  }
560	  function renderTerminal() {
561	    const step = currentStep();
562	    if (!step) return;
563	    if (reviewMode && listShown) {
564	      termHint.textContent = "# entire checkpoint list";
565	      termInput.textContent = "entire checkpoint list";
566	      termInput.classList.remove("is-dim");
567	      if (termCta) termCta.innerHTML = "";
568	      termList?.classList.remove("hidden");
569	      return;
570	    }
571	    termList?.classList.add("hidden");
572	    termHint.textContent = step.hint ? `# ${step.hint}` : "";
573	    if (step.type === "confirm") {
574	      termInput.textContent = `${step.question}  [y/n]`;
575	      termInput.classList.add("is-dim");
576	      if (termCta) termCta.innerHTML =
577	        `<span class="cta-label">PRESS</span>` +
578	        `<kbd class="cta-key cta-key-yes">Y</kbd><span class="cta-note">link checkpoint</span>` +
579	        `<kbd class="cta-key cta-key-no">N</kbd><span class="cta-note">no point</span>`;
580	    } else {
581	      termInput.textContent = buffer;
582	      termInput.classList.remove("is-dim");
583	      if (termCta) termCta.innerHTML =
584	        `<span class="cta-label">TYPE</span><span class="cta-cmd">${step.cmd}</span>`;
585	    }
586	  }
587	  function flashTerminal(text, ok) {
588	    if (!termMsg) return;
589	    clearTimeout(msgTimer);
590	    termMsg.textContent = text;
591	    termMsg.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err");
592	    termMsg.classList.add(ok ? "show-ok" : "show-err");
593	    msgTimer = setTimeout(() => termMsg.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err"), 2400);
594	  }
595	  function submitCommand() {
596	    const step = currentStep();
597	    if (!step || step.type !== "command" || listShown) return;
598	    if (cmdMatches(buffer, step.accept)) {
599	      const teaching = lessonPaused;
600	      buffer = "";
601	      if (reviewMode) { showCheckpointList(); return; }
602	      advanceBank();
603	      if (!teaching) {
604	        flashTerminal("ok", true);
605	        renderTerminal();
606	      }
607	    } else {
608	      flashTerminal(`command not recognized. try: ${step.cmd}`, false);
609	      buffer = "";
610	      renderTerminal();
611	    }
612	  }
613	  function advanceBank() {
614	    if (bankState === "dormant") {
615	      bankState = "recovered";
616	      if (lessonPaused) {
617	        closeTerminal();
618	        lessonNarrating = true;
619	        renderBankLesson();
620	      }
621	    } else if (bankState === "recovered") {
622	      bankState = "frozen";
623	      freezeBankTarget();   // the commit freezes it into ice
624	      if (lessonPaused) {
625	        closeTerminal();
626	        lessonNarrating = true;
627	        renderBankLesson();
628	      }
629	    }
630	  }
631	  function confirmCheckpoint(yes) {
632	    if (bankState !== "frozen") return;
633	    const teaching = lessonPaused;
634	    if (!yes) {
635	      clearBankPiece();
636	      banking = false;
637	      bankState = "done";
638	      closeTerminal();
639	      if (teaching) {
640	        finishBankLesson();
641	        showModePrompt("level");
642	      }
643	      return;
644	    }
645	    const frag = FRAGMENTS[banked % FRAGMENTS.length];
646	    const id = genCheckpointId();
647	    bankedRecords.push({ frag, id });
648	    banked += 1;
649	    updateTally();
650	
651	    // shatter the ice + dismiss the banked record with a little sparkle
652	    if (bankTarget) spawnSpark(bankTarget.position.clone(), 0x8fe3ff);
653	    clearBankPiece();
654	    banking = false;
655	    bankState = "done";
656	    closeTerminal();
657	    if (teaching) {
658	      finishBankLesson();
659	      showModePrompt("level");
660	    }
661	  }
662	  function showCheckpointList() {
663	    listShown = true;
664	    timerRunning = false;
665	    countdownEl?.classList.remove("is-low", "is-critical");
666	    if (termList) {
667	      termList.innerHTML = bankedRecords.map(({ frag, id }) =>
668	        `<div class="term-list-row"><span class="tl-id">` +
669	        `<span class="tl-key">Entire-Checkpoint:</span> ${id}</span>` +
670	        `<span class="tl-title">recovered: ${frag.title}</span></div>`
671	      ).join("");
672	    }
673	    flashTerminal(`${banked} checkpoints linked · ship memory restored`, true);
674	    showTutorial("Memory restored. The drone bay just woke up. Press Enter to investigate · B for orbit.", 0);
675	    renderTerminal();
676	    onComplete?.();
677	  }
678	
679	  // ---------- end of run ----------
680	  // The clock hit 0:00 — branch on whether the minimum was cleared.
681	  function endRun() {
682	    timerRunning = false;
683	    countdownEl?.classList.remove("is-low", "is-critical");
684	    // a record mid-bank when time expired doesn't count
685	    banking = false;
686	    clearBankPiece();
687	    if (banked >= MIN_TO_PASS) passRun();
688	    else failRun();
689	  }
690	  function passRun() {
691	    clearFalling();
692	    reviewMode = true;
693	    openTerminal();             // → review step: type `entire checkpoint list`
694	    showTutorial(`Time. ${banked} records recovered. Run \`entire checkpoint list\` to review your haul.`, 0);
695	  }
696	  function failRun() {
697	    failed = true;
698	    closeTerminal();
699	    tutorialEl?.classList.add("hidden");
700	    if (lfTitle) lfTitle.textContent = "NOT ENOUGH MEMORY";
701	    if (lfSub) lfSub.textContent =
702	      `You recovered ${banked}. The ship needs at least ${MIN_TO_PASS} to power up.`;
703	    levelFail?.classList.remove("hidden");
704	  }
705	  function resetLevel() {
706	    failed = false;
707	    levelFail?.classList.add("hidden");
708	    clearFalling();
709	    clearBankPiece();
710	    banking = false;
711	    reviewMode = false;
712	    listShown = false;
713	    bankState = "dormant";
714	    buffer = "";
715	    banked = 0;
716	    bankedRecords.length = 0;
717	    updateTally();
718	    spawnTimer = 0;
719	    timeLeft = TOTAL_TIME;
720	    timedRunStarted = false;
721	    timerRunning = false;
722	    updateClock();
723	    hideBankLesson();
724	    hideModePrompt();
725	    lessonPaused = false;
726	    lessonNarrating = false;
727	    showModePrompt(bankLessonComplete ? "level" : "tutorial");
728	  }
729	
730	  // ---------- briefing ----------
731	  function showBriefing() {
732	    timerRunning = false;
733	    tutorialEl?.classList.add("hidden");
734	    briefingIndex = 0;
735	    renderBriefingBeat();
736	    briefingEl?.classList.remove("hidden");
737	  }
738	  function startLevel() {
739	    if (started) return;
740	    started = true;
741	    if (modePrompt) {
742	      modePrompt.classList.add("hidden");
743	      delete modePrompt.dataset.mode;
744	    }
745	    modePromptState = null;
746	    modeAction?.blur();
747	    briefingEl?.classList.add("hidden");
748	    timeLeft = TOTAL_TIME;
749	    timedRunStarted = false;
750	    timerRunning = false;
751	    updateTally();
752	    updateClock();
753	    refreshHud();
754	  }
755	  briefingEl?.addEventListener("click", advanceBriefing);
756	  modeAction?.addEventListener("click", acceptModePrompt);
757	
758	  // ---------- input ----------
759	  function onMouseMove(e) {
760	    mouseClient = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
761	    ndc.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
762	    ndc.y = -(e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
763	    if (reticle) {
764	      reticle.style.left = e.clientX + "px";
765	      reticle.style.top = e.clientY + "px";
766	    }
767	  }
768	  function onMouseDown(e) {
769	    if (!active || e.button !== 0) return;
770	    if (visibleModePromptKind()) return;
771	    if (lessonPaused && lessonNarrating) {
772	      openBankLessonTerminal();
773	      return;
774	    }
775	    fire();
776	  }
777	  function onKeyDown(e) {
778	    if (!active) return;
779	
780	    if (visibleModePromptKind()) {
781	      if (e.code === "Enter" || e.code === "Space") {
782	        acceptModePrompt();
783	        e.preventDefault();
784	        return;
785	      }
786	      if (e.code === "KeyB") {
787	        onExit?.();
788	        return;
789	      }
790	      if (e.code !== "KeyB") e.preventDefault();
791	      return;
792	    }
793	
794	    if (!started) {
795	      if (e.code === "Enter" || e.code === "Space") { advanceBriefing(); e.preventDefault(); }
796	      return;
797	    }
798	    if (failed) {
799	      if (e.code === "KeyR") { resetLevel(); e.preventDefault(); }
800	      return;
801	    }
802	    if (lessonPaused && lessonNarrating) {
803	      if (e.code === "Enter" || e.code === "Space") {
804	        openBankLessonTerminal();
805	        e.preventDefault();
806	        return;
807	      }
808	      if (e.code !== "KeyB") {
809	        e.preventDefault();
810	        return;
811	      }
812	    }
813	
814	    // Terminal is open — banking a record or running the final list.
815	    if (terminalOpen) {
816	      const step = currentStep();

868	    applyPanicSky();

870	    // Spawn + fall (paused while banking or after the run ends).
871	    // The rain keeps falling even while you bank — that's the cost of stopping
872	    // to type. (Only pause it once the run is over.)
873	    const raining = started && !reviewMode && !failed && !listShown && !lessonPaused && !visibleModePromptKind();
874	    if (raining) {
875	      spawnTimer -= dt;
876	      if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
877	        spawnDrop();
878	        spawnTimer = lerp(SPAWN_MAX, SPAWN_MIN, difficulty());
879	      }
880	    }
881	    for (let i = falling.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
882	      const f = falling[i];
883	      if (raining) f.group.position.y -= f.vy * dt;
884	      const spin = f.group.userData.spin;
885	      const spinTarget = f.group.userData.spinTarget || f.group;
886	      if (spin) {
887	        spinTarget.rotation.x += spin.x * dt;
888	        spinTarget.rotation.y += spin.y * dt;
889	        spinTarget.rotation.z += spin.z * dt;
890	      }
891	      if (f.kind === "record") {
892	        const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 5 + f.group.position.x * 0.13);
893	        if (f.group.userData.badge) f.group.userData.badge.material.opacity = 0.78 + pulse * 0.18;
894	        if (f.group.userData.trail) f.group.userData.trail.material.opacity = 0.28 + pulse * 0.18;
895	        if (f.group.userData.beacon) f.group.userData.beacon.intensity = 2.2 + pulse * 1.3;

904	      spinTarget.rotation.y += dt * 0.35;

915	    } else if (camera.position.x !== 0 || camera.position.y !== 24) {
916	      camera.position.x = 0;
917	      camera.position.y = 24;

1000	  yoke.position.y = 1.2;
1001	  g.add(yoke);
1002	
1003	  // barrel along +Z

1009	  tip.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
1010	  tip.position.set(0, 1.2, 5.1);

> AGENT

Read through all of it — `islandView.js`, the HUD markup, and the CSS. This is a genuinely clean solve, and it's *not* the "fold the terminal into the card" Option A we'd been circling. You went a better route. Here's what you actually built:

**The flow now**
1. **Briefing** — 4 short pilot-voice beats (`BRIEFING_BEATS`), Space to advance, in the bottom gold story banner. Premise only, zero git. Exactly the "too much up front" fix you wanted.
2. **Mode gate** — "START TUTORIAL · the clock stays off." A title-screen-style centered card. This is the smart new piece.
3. **Tutorial** — clock off, records rain, you shoot one.
4. **First record → the lesson**, and this is the part that kills the overlay problem: the big gold card and the terminal **never show at the same time**. They hand off. Card *STAGE IT / git add* → Space → terminal (type `git add`) → Space → card *FREEZE IT / git commit* → terminal → card *REMEMBER IT / press y* → terminal → `Y`. One surface at a time, every time.
5. **Mode gate again** — "PLAY LEVEL 1 · clock starts now."
6. **Records 2+** — no card ever again. Just the small terminal. The big treatment is a one-time reveal.

So you resolved the collision by **separating in time** (and by wrapping the whole teach in a clock-off tutorial) rather than cramming two boxes together. That's the right call — it reads calm, the gold card stays special, and the timed run is pure arcade. I verified the mutual exclusion in code: `pauseForBankLesson` → `closeTerminal()` then card; `openBankLessonTerminal` → `hideBankLesson()` then terminal; `advanceBank` while teaching → `closeTerminal()` then next card. They can't co-exist. 

**Two small things worth a decision (not bugs):**

1. **The practice record counts.** In `confirmCheckpoint(true)` during the lesson, `banked += 1` fires before `finishBankLesson()`. So the timed run starts at **1/4**, not 0/4 — but on a **retry** (`resetLevel` → straight to "level", banked reset to 0) you start at 0/4 and need the full 4. So first-time players get a free head start that retriers don't. Either is defensible; just flagging the inconsistency. If "practice" should mean practice, don't count it; if it's a gentle on-ramp, maybe match the retry by giving it there too.

2. **Cue wording.** The card cues say "press Space to stage / freeze / link," but Space only *reveals the terminal* — the actual staging is you typing `git add`. Tiny mismatch. Something like "press Space → then type it" or just "Space to continue" might be truer to what the key does.

Both are polish-level. The core structure — briefing → tutorial teach → timed run, one surface at a time — is solid and matches the "story-readable instructions" goal you set out. Want me to leave it as-is, or tweak either of those two?
